new.statement: Inside a template wave the newest entrants take the older clones' places: ragdoll sandboxes about four weeks old fall on Most Popular while two-week-old ones enter and rise
new.action: Enter a wave in its first month
new.rationale: Today Ragdoll Sandbox (27 days, -24), Realistic Ragdoll Engine (31 days, -25) and Ragdoll Reality (30 days, -29) fell most on Most Popular while Ragdoll Realism (16 days) rose 47 and Bloody Ragdoll Physics (12 days) and Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (14 days) entered; on Up-and-Coming Realistic Ragdoll Physics (16 days) fell 24 while Ragdoll Frenzy (9 days) and Pumpkin Playground (12 days) entered. Confirm if by 2026-11-26 the ragdoll games now aged 12-16 days fall while newer ones replace them; refute if the older ragdoll games recover or the wave's chart count shrinks without new entrants.

qualitative_updates.note: The wave still reaches all four charts but rotates: Ragdoll Realism (16 days) rose 47 on Most Popular and Bloody Ragdoll Physics (12 days) and Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (14 days) entered it, while three ragdoll sandboxes aged 27-31 days fell 24-29; physics sandboxes rank higher on Up-and-Coming again (H-uc-036, 42% to 76%) but sit at the bottom of Top Earning (r=-0.58).

Steal mechanics are the strongest negative on Up-and-Coming within age (r=-0.62, 8 games) and Climb For Animals Eggs fell 29 on Most Popular, while Steal An Egg still leads Most Popular; two new steal-egg reskins profiled today (Steal an Nightmare Egg, Be Flash For Eggs) entered Up-and-Coming only in its lower half (#47, #84).

Flee the Facility shipped its late Halloween event on 10 November and rose 415 on Top Earning and re-entered Most Popular at 3,421 days, while Momo City (-168) and other pumpkin-tagged games without a new update fell; a follow-up event, even a late one, goes with gains.
Clone Baby Care (Anomaly) rose 17 on Most Popular at 34 days and Cook Pizzas [Anomaly] entered Top Trending at 20 days, so the format keeps producing climbers.

Two more anime fighting RPGs profiled today sell rerolls and sit on Top Earning with modest audiences: Shibuya (34 days, race and clan rerolls up to 4,500 R$, #136) and Clover Adventure (42 days, grimoire rolls and timed boosters, #236).
Cut a Rock fell off Most Popular today, so the rotating-job games are not yet holding better than finite chores; keep watching Rock In My Lawn on Top Earning.
